manifest.name: Harvest

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the Harvest token and account ID by returning the authenticated user.

clients.list.title: List Clients
clients.list.description: List clients in the Harvest account.

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

projects.list.title: List Projects
projects.list.description: List projects in the Harvest account.

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

tasks.list.title: List Tasks
tasks.list.description: List tasks in the Harvest account.

isDefault.description: Pass true to only return default tasks.

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

timeEntries.list.title: List Time Entries
timeEntries.list.description: List time entries in the Harvest account.

isBilled.description: Pass true for invoiced entries, false for unbilled.

isRunning.description: Pass true for running timers, false for stopped entries.

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

externalReferenceId.description: Only return time entries with this external reference ID.

clients.get.title: Get Client
clients.get.description: Retrieve a Harvest client by ID via GET /v2/clients/{clientId}.

clients.create.title: Create Client
clients.create.description: Create a Harvest client via POST /v2/clients.

name.description: The name of the client or company.

address.description: The client's physical address. May include new line characters.

currency.description: ISO currency code for the client.

isActive.description: Whether the client is active, or archived.

clients.update.title: Update Client
clients.update.description: Update a Harvest client via PATCH /v2/clients/{clientId}. Omit fields to leave them unchanged.

name.description: The name of the client or company.

address.description: The client's physical address. May include new line characters.

currency.description: ISO currency code for the client.

isActive.description: Whether the client is active, or archived.

clients.delete.title: Delete Client
clients.delete.description: Delete a Harvest client via DELETE /v2/clients/{clientId}. The client must have no projects, invoices, or estimates.

contacts.list.title: List Client Contacts
contacts.list.description: List Harvest client contacts via GET /v2/contacts with optional client and pagination filters.

perPage.description: Number of records to return per page (1-2000).

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

contacts.create.title: Create Client Contact
contacts.create.description: Create a Harvest client contact via POST /v2/contacts.

contacts.update.title: Update Client Contact
contacts.update.description: Update a Harvest client contact via PATCH /v2/contacts/{contactId}.

contacts.delete.title: Delete Client Contact
contacts.delete.description: Permanently delete a Harvest client contact via DELETE /v2/contacts/{contactId}.

company.get.title: Get Company Info
company.get.description: Retrieve the authenticated Harvest company via GET /v2/company.

company.update.title: Update Company Info
company.update.description: Update company time-tracking settings via PATCH /v2/company. Only wants_timestamp_timers and weekly_capacity are writable.

wantsTimestampTimers.description: True to track start/end times; false to track duration.

weeklyCapacity.description: Weekly capacity in seconds, e.g. 144000 for 40 hours.

projects.get.title: Get Project
projects.get.description: Retrieve a Harvest project by ID via GET /v2/projects/{projectId}.

projects.create.title: Create Project
projects.create.description: Create a Harvest project via POST /v2/projects. Requires client, name, and billing configuration.

isFixedFee.description: Whether the project is a fixed-fee project.

budget.description: Monetary or hour budget depending on budget_by.

budgetIsMonthly.description: Whether the budget resets every month.

notifyWhenOverBudget.description: Whether to notify when over budget.

overBudgetNotificationPercentage.description: Percentage that triggers the over-budget notification.

showBudgetToAll.description: Whether the budget is visible to all project members.

costBudgetIncludeExpenses.description: Whether expenses are included in the cost budget.

hourlyRate.description: Default hourly rate when billing by project.

fee.description: Fee when billing by project / fixed fee.

projects.update.title: Update Project
projects.update.description: Update a Harvest project via PATCH /v2/projects/{projectId}. Omit fields to leave them unchanged.

isFixedFee.description: Whether the project is a fixed-fee project.

budget.description: Monetary or hour budget depending on budget_by.

budgetIsMonthly.description: Whether the budget resets every month.

notifyWhenOverBudget.description: Whether to notify when over budget.

overBudgetNotificationPercentage.description: Percentage that triggers the over-budget notification.

showBudgetToAll.description: Whether the budget is visible to all project members.

costBudgetIncludeExpenses.description: Whether expenses are included in the cost budget.

hourlyRate.description: Default hourly rate when billing by project.

fee.description: Fee when billing by project / fixed fee.

projects.delete.title: Delete Project
projects.delete.description: Delete a Harvest project via DELETE /v2/projects/{projectId}. Associated time entries and expenses are removed; invoices remain.

tasks.get.title: Get Task
tasks.get.description: Retrieve a Harvest task by ID via GET /v2/tasks/{taskId}.

tasks.create.title: Create Task
tasks.create.description: Create a Harvest task via POST /v2/tasks. Tasks are reusable activity types assigned to projects.

name.description: Task name. Must be unique in the account.

isDefault.description: Whether this task is added to future projects by default.

billableByDefault.description: Whether the task is billable by default on projects.

defaultHourlyRate.description: Default hourly rate when added to a project.

tasks.update.title: Update Task
tasks.update.description: Update a Harvest task via PATCH /v2/tasks/{taskId}.

name.description: Task name. Must be unique in the account.

isDefault.description: Whether this task is added to future projects by default.

billableByDefault.description: Whether the task is billable by default on projects.

defaultHourlyRate.description: Default hourly rate when added to a project.

tasks.delete.title: Delete Task
tasks.delete.description: Delete a Harvest task via DELETE /v2/tasks/{taskId}. The task must have no associated time entries.

timeEntries.get.title: Get Time Entry
timeEntries.get.description: Retrieve a Harvest time entry by ID via GET /v2/time_entries/{timeEntryId}.

timeEntries.create.title: Create Time Entry
timeEntries.create.description: Create a Harvest time entry via POST /v2/time_entries. Supply hours for duration tracking, or started_time/ended_time for timestamps.

hours.description: Decimal hours when the account tracks duration.

notes.description: Notes or description of the work performed.

timeEntries.update.title: Update Time Entry
timeEntries.update.description: Update a Harvest time entry via PATCH /v2/time_entries/{timeEntryId}.

hours.description: Decimal hours when the account tracks duration.

notes.description: Notes or description of the work performed.

timeEntries.delete.title: Delete Time Entry
timeEntries.delete.description: Delete a Harvest time entry via DELETE /v2/time_entries/{timeEntryId}.

expenses.create.title: Create Expense
expenses.create.description: Create a Harvest expense via POST /v2/expenses. Provide units for unit-based categories or total_cost otherwise. Receipt multipart upload is not supported.

units.description: Quantity of units for unit-based categories.

receipt.description: Ignored: Harvest receipt upload requires multipart/form-data, which this tool does not send.

expenses.update.title: Update Expense
expenses.update.description: Update a Harvest expense via PATCH /v2/expenses/{expenseId}. Pass deleteReceipt=true to remove an attached receipt.

units.description: Quantity of units for unit-based categories.

deleteReceipt.description: Pass true to delete the attached receipt.

expenseCategories.list.title: List Expense Categories
expenseCategories.list.description: List Harvest expense categories via GET /v2/expense_categories.

isActive.description: Pass true for active records, false for archived.

perPage.description: Number of records to return per page (1-2000).

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

invoices.list.title: List Invoices
invoices.list.description: List Harvest invoices via GET /v2/invoices. Filter by client, project, state, or issue-date range.

state.description: Only return invoices in this state.

perPage.description: Number of records to return per page (1-2000).

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

invoices.get.title: Get Invoice
invoices.get.description: Retrieve a Harvest invoice by ID via GET /v2/invoices/{invoiceId}.

invoices.create.title: Create Invoice
invoices.create.description: Create a Harvest invoice via POST /v2/invoices. Requires a client and line items.

tax.description: First tax rate applied to the invoice (0-100).

tax2.description: Second tax rate applied to the invoice (0-100).

discount.description: Percentage discount applied to the invoice (0-100).

kind.description: Invoice/estimate item category name, e.g. Service.

invoices.update.title: Update Invoice
invoices.update.description: Update a Harvest invoice via PATCH /v2/invoices/{invoiceId}. Omit fields to leave them unchanged.

tax.description: First tax rate applied to the invoice (0-100).

tax2.description: Second tax rate applied to the invoice (0-100).

discount.description: Percentage discount applied to the invoice (0-100).

kind.description: Invoice/estimate item category name, e.g. Service.

invoices.delete.title: Delete Invoice
invoices.delete.description: Delete a Harvest invoice via DELETE /v2/invoices/{invoiceId}.

invoiceItemCategories.list.title: List Invoice Item Categories
invoiceItemCategories.list.description: List Harvest invoice item categories via GET /v2/invoice_item_categories.

perPage.description: Number of records to return per page (1-2000).

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

invoiceItemCategories.create.title: Create Invoice Item Category
invoiceItemCategories.create.description: Create a Harvest invoice item category via POST /v2/invoice_item_categories.

name.description: Name of the invoice item category.

invoiceItemCategories.delete.title: Delete Invoice Item Category
invoiceItemCategories.delete.description: Delete a Harvest invoice item category via DELETE /v2/invoice_item_categories/{invoiceItemCategoryId}. Both use_as_service and use_as_expense must be false.

invoiceMessages.list.title: List Invoice Messages
invoiceMessages.list.description: List messages for a Harvest invoice via GET /v2/invoices/{invoiceId}/messages.

perPage.description: Number of records to return per page (1-2000).

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

invoiceMessages.create.title: Create Invoice Message
invoiceMessages.create.description: Create an invoice message via POST /v2/invoices/{invoiceId}/messages. Use eventType to send, close, reopen, or save a draft.

recipients.description: Message recipients. Required when sending unless sendMeACopy is true.

includeLinkToClientInvoice.description: Deprecated Harvest flag for payment options.

attachPdf.description: If true, attach a PDF of the invoice.

sendMeACopy.description: If true, email a copy to the current user.

thankYou.description: If true, send a thank-you message.

eventType.description: Invoice event: send, draft, close, or re-open.

invoiceMessages.delete.title: Delete Invoice Message
invoiceMessages.delete.description: Delete an invoice message via DELETE /v2/invoices/{invoiceId}/messages/{messageId}.

invoicePayments.list.title: List Invoice Payments
invoicePayments.list.description: List payments recorded on a Harvest invoice via GET /v2/invoices/{invoiceId}/payments.

perPage.description: Number of records to return per page (1-2000).

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

invoicePayments.create.title: Create Invoice Payment
invoicePayments.create.description: Record a payment on a Harvest invoice via POST /v2/invoices/{invoiceId}/payments. Provide paidAt or paidDate.

paidAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time the payment was made.

sendThankYou.description: Whether to send a thank-you email when the invoice becomes fully paid.

invoicePayments.delete.title: Delete Invoice Payment
invoicePayments.delete.description: Delete an invoice payment via DELETE /v2/invoices/{invoiceId}/payments/{paymentId}.

estimates.get.title: Get Estimate
estimates.get.description: Retrieve a Harvest estimate by ID via GET /v2/estimates/{estimateId}.

estimates.create.title: Create Estimate
estimates.create.description: Create a Harvest estimate via POST /v2/estimates.

number.description: If omitted, Harvest auto-generates the estimate number.

tax.description: First tax percentage applied to subtotal.

tax2.description: Second tax percentage applied to subtotal.

notes.description: Additional notes to include on the estimate.

currency.description: Currency code; defaults to the client's currency.

kind.description: Invoice/estimate item category name, e.g. Service.

estimates.update.title: Update Estimate
estimates.update.description: Update a Harvest estimate via PATCH /v2/estimates/{estimateId}.

number.description: If omitted, Harvest auto-generates the estimate number.

tax.description: First tax percentage applied to subtotal.

tax2.description: Second tax percentage applied to subtotal.

notes.description: Additional notes to include on the estimate.

currency.description: Currency code; defaults to the client's currency.

kind.description: Invoice/estimate item category name, e.g. Service.

estimates.delete.title: Delete Estimate
estimates.delete.description: Delete a Harvest estimate via DELETE /v2/estimates/{estimateId}.

estimateItemCategories.create.title: Create Estimate Item Category
estimateItemCategories.create.description: Create a Harvest estimate item category via POST /v2/estimate_item_categories.

name.description: Name of the estimate item category.

estimateItemCategories.update.title: Update Estimate Item Category
estimateItemCategories.update.description: Update a Harvest estimate item category via PATCH /v2/estimate_item_categories/{estimateItemCategoryId}.

estimateMessages.list.title: List Estimate Messages
estimateMessages.list.description: List messages for a Harvest estimate via GET /v2/estimates/{estimateId}/messages.

perPage.description: Number of records to return per page (1-2000).

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

estimateMessages.create.title: Create Estimate Message
estimateMessages.create.description: Create an estimate message via POST /v2/estimates/{estimateId}/messages. Use eventType to send, accept, decline, or re-open.

recipients.description: Message recipients. Required unless this is an event-only call.

sendMeACopy.description: If true, email a copy to the current user.

eventType.description: Estimate event: send, accept, decline, or re-open.

estimateMessages.delete.title: Delete Estimate Message
estimateMessages.delete.description: Delete an estimate message via DELETE /v2/estimates/{estimateId}/messages/{messageId}.

isActive.description: Pass true for active records, false for archived.

perPage.description: Number of records to return per page (1-2000).

updatedSince.description: Only return records updated since this ISO 8601 timestamp.

users.get.title: Get User
users.get.description: Retrieve a Harvest user by ID via GET /v2/users/{userId}.

users.create.title: Create User
users.create.description: Invite a Harvest user via POST /v2/users. Harvest emails the address to activate the account.

timezone.description: Rails timezone name, e.g. Eastern Time (US & Canada).

isContractor.description: Whether the user is a contractor.

hasAccessToAllFutureProjects.description: Automatically add the user to future projects.

defaultHourlyRate.description: Default billable rate when added to a project.

costRate.description: Cost rate used when calculating project costs.

roles.description: Business-role names used for reporting filters.

accessRoles.description: Harvest access roles that grant permissions.

users.update.title: Update User
users.update.description: Update a Harvest user via PATCH /v2/users/{userId}.

timezone.description: Rails timezone name, e.g. Eastern Time (US & Canada).

isContractor.description: Whether the user is a contractor.

hasAccessToAllFutureProjects.description: Automatically add the user to future projects.

defaultHourlyRate.description: Default billable rate when added to a project.

costRate.description: Cost rate used when calculating project costs.

roles.description: Business-role names used for reporting filters.

accessRoles.description: Harvest access roles that grant permissions.

users.delete.title: Delete User
users.delete.description: Delete a Harvest user via DELETE /v2/users/{userId}. The user must have no time entries or expenses.

manifest.description: Time tracking, invoicing, estimates, expenses, and project management for Harvest.
